steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow required to configure a rank-based auction.
Configure the event as a rank-based auction awarded to one vendor.
Apply the first available auction template.
Add one item for the auction.
Invite two vendors so the auction has competing bids.
Confirm the auction reached a real published project page.
Place a bid for one vendor at a known price that can be checked as hidden from the other vendor.
Confirm the first vendor's bid was accepted.
Open the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open the auction pricing round as the vendor.
Submit the second vendor's own bid and leave the vendor bid screen available for inspection.
Assert that the vendor screen exposes rank feedback.
Assert that the known competing bid price is not visible to this vendor.
